'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Angelo Consoli LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Keiya (V) → [[Kabe]]. Obi-Wan EPP → [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]]. Line 59 Come Here published as written (may redlink). Boldon's Eye → [[Beldon's Eye (V)]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Angelo Consoli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
